name: South Korea
notes: Depth: partial seed. Scope: national; regional and local supporters have not been systematically researched. Geography and map use SGIS-derived 2026-10-01 boundaries (CC BY 4.0; Statistics Korea KOGL Type 1), with non-autonomous districts merged into their city. Codes await independent comparison with an official current list. Historical statements do not establish current support.

polls.scope: South Korea, adults aged 19 and over
polls.question: A wealth tax on ultra-high earners (the exact wording is not published)
polls.fieldwork: March 2019 (commissioned 12 March; exact dates not stated)
